title: Moving dyadic witnesses and all-degree projective collapse of the beta transducer

artifacts.role: moving-dyadic construction, projective nonlinear collapse proof, admission, and strict scope
proposed ledger delta; no canonical edit

proved: For every n>=6 and every moving s with 2^s<=2n-3, an explicit canonical positive-branch witness satisfies U=a mod 2^s but U!=a.
The witness lies in the exact intermediate window, has 0<|E|<c, and carries Item 323's full universal all-depth unit-strip transducer.
For every canonical word, L_j-H_jL_m=-bN_j and all two-depth minors have an exact factor b.
For D|b and unit R, the residual vector has fixed projective direction H modulo D.
Every homogeneous polynomial of arbitrary degree and depth portfolio collapses by F(L)=R^degree F(H) modulo D.
Every general polynomial reduces to one scalar R; on an actual target R is the already-known signed square ray modulo D.
The canonical comparator R=1 lies below the target window but has L=H exactly.

closes: moving dyadic target truncations with 2^s<=2n-3 and no additional odd coprimality input
all digit-independent projectively homogeneous congruence tests on the Item-323 residual tower, at arbitrary depth and degree
does_not_close: dyadic precision above 2n-3, full dyadic equality, or dyadic/odd coupling
divided quotients, suffix loads, or mod b^2 and higher information
integer-size nonlinear invariants or canonical complement redigitization
a proper-target lower bound or weighted return cover
Route 1 or any conclusion about e+pi

PROVED: exact projective rank-one and arbitrary-degree polynomial collapse
OPEN: the original all-digit exclusion and centered half-bound
super-logarithmic/full dyadic, divided-quotient, higher-modulus, integer-size, and redigitized routes
proper targets and every capacity consequence
